ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: As shown in the figure, fold the equilateral triangle $\triangle ABC$ such that point $B$ falls exactly on point $D$ on side $AC$. The crease is $EF$, and $O$ is a moving point on crease $EF$. If $AD=1$ and $AC=3$, then what is the minimum perimeter of $\triangle OCD$?
ready1_open_rewrite.raw_answer_text:
\textbf{Solution:} As shown in the figure, connect BD, OB, \\
$\because$ by folding the equilateral $\triangle ABC$ so that point B falls exactly on point D on side AC, \\
$\therefore$ EF is the axis of symmetry of BD, \\
$\therefore$ OB=OD, \\
$\because$ AD=1, AC=3, \\
$\therefore$ CD=2, \\
$\because$ the perimeter of $\triangle OCD$ = CD+OD+OC = 2+BO+OC, \\
$\therefore$ when points B, O, and C are collinear, the minimum perimeter of $\triangle OCD$ = 2+BC = \boxed{5},
